L1 System of Record

  • 47 atomic event types chained by canonical JSON SHA-256 hashes
  • Deterministic replay rebuilds exact state and verifies snapshotDigest
  • Linear-time secret redaction runs before any byte touches disk

BMAD Bridge Crew

  • Engineering, Security, and Bridge Officers audit live workspace telemetry
  • Round 2 peer challenges are verified against concrete check evidence
  • Knowledge updates require proven positive KPI delta > 0

Distributed Integrity

  • Directory, GitHub Projects v2, and Jira stay synced via ledger hashes
  • Unsupported or oversized artifacts stay intact in .numberone fallback blobs
  • Every outbound request enforces SSRF and origin-scoped token checks
